Acme Robotics — Research Notes

Acme Robotics builds warehouse automation hardware for mid-market logistics
operators. The company was founded in 2021 by Ada Okonkwo and Grace Lin, both
previously at a larger robotics firm.

The Series A closed in March 2026 at $12M, led by Initech Ventures. Existing
seed investors participated. The round values the company at roughly $70M
post-money, according to two people familiar with the terms.

Competition comes mainly from incumbents selling fixed conveyor systems, whose
installations take months rather than days. Acme's pitch is time-to-value.
